title: Complete deep-world workflow: DWF1–211, source chronology, consumer evidence and current authority
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: complete long workflow/palette and research chronology; prior partial range promoted after actual full read
reviews.disposition:
Full content review covers all980 pre-fold lines in seven complete slices:1–150,151–300,301–450,451–600,601–750,751–900,901–980. DWF1–DWF211 (including34a and the withdrawn187), all stage/axis/overlay/census/source/route/mechanism/body tables, research results, local-churn and later B68/B69 qualifications were read. This is the complete workflow body, not fresh reading of linked census rows, private chapters, code or raw local-model outputs.

**Authority and horizon.** These are successive proposals, requested research runs and separately authorized delivery pointers, not211 standing rules or a new dispatch. DWF106 records adoption of the proof-tier change into AD36; that does not adopt every neighboring workflow policy. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md), [world-pass rules](WORLD_PASS_RULES.md), [making](MAKING_RULES.md) and actual source/runtime owners govern scope. LOTM-first/HP-after-old-Seer, pack-second-world waits, model tiers, response/source ceilings and named-source availability are dated. AD51 allows the first useful shared seam; the broader lead/ordinary-lives goals and user-selected whole-source horizon are not replaced by a small ring. Census and useful play can progress together, but neither closes the other's explicitly selected denominator. No pipeline, swarm, local churn, acquisition or source pass is resumed here.

**Source evidence remains per claim.** Early1402-read/363-reviewed and later1178-review figures,466 LOTM rows/462 notes/four checked, HP256 rows and changing full/window/search labels are dated heterogeneous products. Later32 full/224 window checks supersede selected earlier HP states, not seven-book scene/counter fidelity. Extraction, search, note reuse,1200-character windows, targeted EPUB members, grammar confidence and full-scene/primary qualification differ. DWF50's remaining items and DWF64's approximate open count retain their sidecar boundaries; a complete census is not a complete canon audit. Twelve ingredient-member searches did not establish a universal ingredient rule or prove its absence; sidecar resolutions do not upgrade all catalog rows. Official pages/search summaries without captured revisions remain qualified, not exact primary chapter support. On-demand item audits resolve consequential source claims under existing locators without repeating whole-source reading by default.

**Mechanisms govern use and information.** Possessed text, learned knowledge, actual faculty, physical source/tool and executable outcome differ, while a genuine direct transmission can supply stronger capability through its means. Named formulas are attractors, not exclusive permission lists; improvisation can work without a universal extra cost, mandatory failure, understanding bar or compensatory drawback. Aliases, stated alternates, quantity changes, graded tool fit and unknown laws must not be conflated. Food, extinction, danger, faction contribution, institutional refusal, purchasing attention, secrecy, pollution and bypass costs follow selected world causes, not one automatic tax or meter. A real superior/free/unlimited faculty remains possible. Ritual conditions may need momentary, sustained or historical support; a generic fit score and final-frame check do not establish every transition law. Institutional law/standing is distinct from physical possibility, including for persons with unusual bodies.

**Shared shape is a bounded engineering proposal.** Process envelope versus product behavior, acquisition versus ingestion, recipe versus practice, held versus leased support, distinct actor/lot/claim/custody identity, elapsed work versus exterior event and source truth versus observer account remain useful seams. Reuse actual owners; a catalogue/derived tag/role/route row does not implement its consumer, another save key or a universal interpreter. DWF95/115's broad port-first order and DWF114's bespoke default do not delay a selected useful slice. Automatic role vacancy replacement cannot restore a canon outcome after its cause disappears; successors need real means and motives. Everyone-knows/news must pass actual channels. UI catalogues and shallow markers are proposals, not generic actions or a license to reveal hidden counts/labels. Stable row IDs alone do not establish compatible definitions or old-save meaning.

**Later consumers qualify the old gaps.** B473's complete dose receipt and B475's generator show selected process/bench/drink/acting consumers beyond round4's sparse counts, with explicit unrun/higher-pathway gaps. The specimen-processing checkpoint preserves actual identity/age/damage/FIFO/source tests and incomplete native process journey; rows DWF193–DWF210 are broader proposals, not all delivered anatomy/ecology/spoilage. Processing is not guaranteed reversible crafting: retained parts, consumed heat/medium, contamination and actual source-supported restoration have their own laws. Living harvest, original bodies, legal rights, transport and work capacity differ; a sell action can be useful without a compulsory crafting chain. Source-derived terms require actual essential evidence rather than a table heading or imported franchise memory.

**Proof and history.** Local-churn pilot speed/free disk and title-level triage were measured or reviewed at their exact narrow scope. B67–B69 later actual body reading qualifies that earlier title-only limit without making machine drafts canon. Canary absence does not prove every secret safe; unique-line/voice ratios do not decide fun or require every line uniquely name its speaker. Compression preserves gameplay-relevant identities, obligations, custody and knowledge; short prose is not arbitrary history loss. Current AD36/AD43 determine applicable tests/browser/persistence; sampled row proof is scoped to its shared semantics and changed conditions, not every authored row's exact behavior. DWF117/125 do not authorize deleting tests or changing saves in this reconciliation. AD42 leaves human review optional. The current desktop sizes and actual14/21px checks qualify historical layout targets. No primary/source corpus, private census/sidecar, original raw draft, runtime, test/build/browser, process, package, install or saved game was newly inspected or executed by this document review.

reviews.reopen: Use named DWF/source/consumer under current horizon and actual owning evidence; preserve proposals and history without restarting old queues or universalizing local policies.
